tool_calls.purpose: Create the minimum Phase 1 record surface and bootstrap records.

commands.command: mkdir -p work_packages/backlog work_packages/active work_packages/done runs reviews game scripts
commands.notes: Created the empty repository surfaces required before applying tracked placeholder files.

commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
pairs = [
  ('schemas/work_package.schema.json', 'work_packages/done/WP-2026W22-001.json'),
  ('schemas/run.schema.json', 'runs/RUN-20260527-001.json'),
  ('schemas/review.schema.json', 'reviews/RV-20260527-001.json'),
]
for schema_path, data_path in pairs:
    schema = json.loads(Path(schema_path).read_text())
    data = json.loads(Path(data_path).read_text())
    Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(data)
    print(f'valid {data_path}')
PY
commands.notes: Blocked because this environment does not have the Python jsonschema module installed.

commands.command: npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/work_package.schema.json -d work_packages/done/WP-2026W22-001.json && npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/run.schema.json -d runs/RUN-20260527-001.json && npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/review.schema.json -d reviews/RV-20260527-001.json
commands.notes: All three bootstrap records validated. AJV warned that date and date-time formats were ignored because no format plugin was loaded.
Confirmed that Slice 1 did not create a Godot project.

notes: No Godot project, build script, smoke-test script, CI, adapter, model router, or web export artifact was created. Schema validation passed through AJV; Python jsonschema validation was unavailable in this environment.
